description: A beetle in green and blue enamel, legs folded neat. Too handsome to squash, and in no position to object.
lore: The shell does not dull and does not fade, which makes it the brooch of anybody who cannot afford a brooch. Pinned at the throat it reads as enamel from four feet, and only the very rude look closer. [[characters/54bead23|Osric]] bought one last spring for a birthday, which is a thing almost nobody here keeps any more — he still counts in living years and marks the date the way he marked it before. He was two months out. He gave it anyway, and it is being worn.
gm_notes: Osric's living calendar, still running and slightly wrong. Who is wearing it is deliberately unsaid; the beetle is a cheap way to find out who he is fond of.
